data.title: Real Madrid Urged to Let Vinicius Jr. Leave Amid Contract Standoff
data.excerpt: Real Madrid are facing a difficult decision over the future of Vinicius Jr., with growing calls for the Spanish giants to consider selling him at the end of the season. The Brazilian winger, 25, has two years left on his contract but has so far refused to sign an extension. Reports indicate that he is demanding an increase from his current €400,577 (£345,369) per week to around €600,962 (£518,137), a figure the club is unwilling to meet. His stance has placed Real in a precarious situation. Allowing him to run down his contract could result in the forward leaving for free in 2027. Questions are now being asked over whether Vinicius Jr. still represents value to the club. His off-field controversies have only added to the tension. The latest incident came during Real Madrid’s recent clash with Real Oviedo. The forward appeared to taunt the home supporters by holding up two fingers after scoring. The gesture interpreted as a suggestion that Oviedo would be relegated. The club’s leadership is understood to be growing frustrated, especially after being pipped to last season’s LaLiga title and Copa del Rey crown by arch-rivals Barcelona. Vinicius has spoken publicly about his ambitions, stating he wants to “make history” with Real Madrid. But that promise is starting to ring hollow inside the Santiago Bernabéu.

data.content:
Manchester City begin their 2025-26 Premier League season with a trip to Molineux on Saturday to face Wolves. Read our preview of the Wolves vs Manchester City match.

Pep Guardiola’s men will aim to make a strong start in their quest for a seventh league title in nine years, while the hosts look to upset the champions early on.

Betting Preview for Wolves vs Manchester City 

  • Venue: Old Trafford
  • Date: 17th August, 2025
  • Time: 16:30 BST
  • Teams to play: Man Utd VS Arsenal
  • Odds as provided by 1XBet

Betting On Wolves

  • 1XBet Spread: +1.5
  • 1XBet Moneyline: 7.03
  • 1XBet Over/Under: Over 2.5

Wolves enter this season looking to rebound from a summer of major changes, including the departure of Matheus Cunha, Aït-Nouri, and captain Nelson Semedo. Vitor Pereira’s side endured a winless pre-season and will be hoping new arrivals can spark a turnaround.

Jhon Arias, signed from Fluminense after an impressive Club World Cup campaign, could be the creative spark Wolves need, while David Moller Wolfe is in line for his debut at left wing-back. Yerson Mosquera is working his way back from injury, and Jorgen Strand Larsen will lead the attack.

Wolves have struggled against City in recent years, losing nine of their last ten meetings, but they will draw inspiration from their 2-1 home win in September 2023.

Betting On Manchester City

  • 1XBet Spread: -1.5
  • 1XBet Moneyline: 1.472
  • 1XBet Over/Under: Under 2.5

City’s preparations have been hampered by injuries and a short pre-season. Rodri is a doubt with a groin issue, while Phil Foden, Claudio Echeverri, and Mateo Kovacic are also injury concerns.

Even with those setbacks, City’s quality remains high. A summer addition from Wolves bolsters their squad, and Guardiola will expect a fast start despite last season’s patchy away form. The champions beat Wolves home and away last season, both by a one-goal margin, and will look for another composed performance here.

MatchPlug Prediction for Wolves vs Manchester City

Wolves’ lack of cutting edge without Cunha and a poor pre-season record may prove costly against a City side that usually grinds out wins in these fixtures. 

Expect a competitive but ultimately controlled display from Guardiola’s men.

Prediction: Manchester City Moneyline
